entities.name: Mairsil
entities.description: The Pretender, who asks what one has that he cannot obtain.

entities.description: Task Mage.

entities.name: Disa the Restless
entities.description: Writer of a journal entry about a shaman's staff.

entities.description: Samite Alchemist.

entities.description: Figure whose legacy lives on in Wizards' School.

entities.name: Halvor Arenson
entities.description: Kjeldoran Priest.

entities.name: Kjeld

entities.description: Soldevi Machinist.

entities.description: Kjeldoran Royal Mage.

entities.name: Chandler
entities.description: A speaker who joked about a lost conscience.

entities.name: Reveka
entities.description: Wizard Savant.

entities.name: Juniper Order

entities.description: The cabal behind Kjeldoran supremacy.

entities.name: Aysen

entities.name: Dominia

entities.description: A haunted forest where fierce elves live.

entities.name: Ronom Glacier
entities.description: Where Feldon found the first cane.

entities.name: Antiquities war
entities.description: The war between Urza and Mishra that made Dominia a casualty.

events.summary: Followers of Leitbur make it their mission to eradicate the Order of the Ebon Hand.
events.quote: who made it their mission to eradicate the Order of the Ebon Hand.

events.summary: The Order of Leitbur fares worse against Orcish and Goblin raiders.
events.quote: the Order of Leitbur was not as successful in later conflicts with Orcish and Goblin raiders.

events.summary: Serra's Gargoyles still guard the city although she has not been seen for twenty years.
events.quote: "Though Serra has not been seen for twenty years, her Gargoyles still watch over our city and punish the guilty."

events.summary: Icatia's towns become armed camps by the time the empire falls.
events.quote: By the time the empire fell, they were little more than armed camps.

events.summary: Baron Sengir states he killed the An-Zerrins.
events.quote: "The An-Zerrins have served me well, ever since I first killed them."

events.summary: Ib Halfheart panics at a Blinking Spirit.
events.quote: "Don't look at it! Maybe it'll go away!"

events.summary: Zur the Enchanter declares he will sacrifice anything for eternal life.
events.quote: "I will go to any length to achieve my goal. Eternal life is worth any sacrifice."

events.summary: Tourach is deified by followers after his death.
events.quote: "Tourach's power was such that his followers deified him after his death."

events.summary: Baris denounces Ihsan as a betrayer who shamed the Serra Paladins.
events.quote: He has brought shame to the Serra Paladins where none existed before.

events.summary: Leshrac warns Lim-Dûl of the coming darkness.
events.quote: Share this vision with your enemies, Lim-Dûl, and they shall wither."

events.summary: Avram Garrisson demands Kjeldor be supreme at any cost.
events.quote: "Kjeldor must be supreme at any cost."

events.summary: Mishra invents the Rack in earlier days.
events.quote: Invented in Mishra's earlier days, the Rack was once his most feared creation.

events.summary: The war between Urza and Mishra makes Dominia a casualty.
events.quote: the war between Urza and Mishra made Dominia itself a casualty of war.

events.summary: Followers of Leitbur guard pillaged transcriptions of the Hymn.
events.quote: Knowing the Hymn's power, the followers of Leitbur carefully guarded their pillaged transcriptions.

events.summary: Feldon finds a cane in the Ronom Glacier.
events.quote: Feldon found the first of these canes frozen in the Ronom Glacier.

events.summary: Zeki describes the Baron's vault of horrors.
events.quote: but the Baron keeps no mercy in his vault of horrors."

events.summary: Disa the Restless records a shaman making the land go mad.
events.quote: "The Shaman waved the staff, and the land itself went mad."

events.summary: Eron the Relentless makes a truce with the people of Aysen.
events.quote: "The people of Aysen feed us, and we don't kill them. That's my kind of truce."

events.summary: Kolbjörn says Freyalise cleansed the Kjeldorans of plague and gave them Fyndhorn.
events.quote: "Freyalise has cleansed our bodies and minds of the plagues of Kjeldor;

events.summary: Halvor Arenson invokes the hallowed ground where Kjeld's blood was spilled.
events.quote: "On this site where Kjeld's blood was spilled, let none raise a fist or deny a beggar."

events.summary: Arcum Dagsson explains the name 'Bone Crank'.
events.quote: "The scavengers who first found it called it the 'Bone Crank.' Not a bad name, I'd say."
